### Health Analytics with R · Module 08: Reproducible Research & Deployment
***
**Learning objectives**
- Build a production plumber REST API for clinical model serving
- Implement request/response validation for patient features
- Create single and batch prediction endpoints
- Write an API test suite with edge cases and error handling
- Add filters: CORS, logging, rate limiting, authentication
- Containerise with Docker and docker-compose for deployment

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `plumber`, `jsonlite`, `xgboost`

## 1. Setup — Train & Save Model

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(xgboost)
library(jsonlite)
library(fs)

mod08_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod08")
dir.create(mod08_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

col_blue <- "#2563EB"
col_red  <- "#DC2626"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "grey40")
    )
)

set.seed(42)
N <- 2000
sigmoid <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
age  <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 60, 15), 18), 90))
los  <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
dm   <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.35)
hf   <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.22)
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.18)
logit <- -3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * dm + 0.3 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 60) +
  0.2 * as.integer(los > 7)
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sigmoid(logit))
df <- tibble(age = age, los_days = los, diabetes = dm, hf = hf, copd = copd,
             readmitted = readmitted)
FEATURES <- c("age", "los_days", "diabetes", "hf", "copd")
split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = readmitted)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
model <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
                eval_metric = "auc"),
  data = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(train[FEATURES]), label = train$readmitted),
  nrounds = 200, verbose = 0
)
auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(test$readmitted, predict(model, as.matrix(test[FEATURES])), quiet = TRUE))
model_path <- file.path(mod08_dir, "readmission_model.rds")
saveRDS(model, model_path)
cat(sprintf("Model trained | AUC=%.4f | Saved: %s\n", auc, model_path))
```

## 2. plumber Architecture for Clinical APIs

```
POST /predict           <- Single patient prediction
POST /predict/batch     <- Batch predictions (list of patients)
GET  /health            <- Health check (for Docker/k8s)
GET  /model/info        <- Model metadata
GET  /__docs__          <- plumber Swagger UI (auto-generated)
GET  /metrics           <- Prometheus metrics (optional)

Request flow:
  HTTP Request
    -> plumber parser (raise 400 if invalid JSON)
    -> Filters (auth, logging, rate limit)
    -> Endpoint function
    -> predict(model, type = "response")
    -> JSON serialisation
    -> HTTP Response (JSON)
```

## 3. Complete plumber Application

```{r}
PLUMBER_APP <- paste(
  c(
    "# plumber.R -- plumber Clinical Readmission API",
    "library(plumber)",
    "library(jsonlite)",
    "library(xgboost)",
    "",
    "MODEL_PATH <- Sys.getenv('MODEL_PATH', 'readmission_model.rds')",
    "MODEL <- readRDS(MODEL_PATH)",
    "FEATURES <- c('age', 'los_days', 'diabetes', 'hf', 'copd')",
    "",
    "risk_tier <- function(prob) {",
    "  if (prob < 0.10) 'Low' else if (prob < 0.20) 'Moderate'",
    "  else if (prob < 0.35) 'High' else 'Very High'",
    "}",
    "",
    "validate_patient <- function(age, los_days, diabetes, hf, copd) {",
    "  errors <- character()",
    "  if (is.null(age) || age < 18 || age > 90) errors <- c(errors, paste('age must be 18-90, got', age))",
    "  if (is.null(los_days) || los_days < 1 || los_days > 60) errors <- c(errors, paste('los_days must be 1-60, got', los_days))",
    "  if (!diabetes %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, 'diabetes must be 0 or 1')",
    "  if (!hf %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, 'hf must be 0 or 1')",
    "  if (!copd %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, 'copd must be 0 or 1')",
    "  errors",
    "}",
    "",
    "predict_one <- function(age, los_days, diabetes, hf, copd, patient_id = NULL) {",
    "  X <- matrix(c(age, los_days, diabetes, hf, copd), nrow = 1,",
    "              dimnames = list(NULL, FEATURES))",
    "  prob <- as.numeric(predict(MODEL, X))",
    "  list(",
    "    patient_id = patient_id,",
    "    readmission_probability = round(prob, 4),",
    "    risk_tier = risk_tier(prob),",
    "    model_version = '1.0.0',",
    "    prediction_timestamp = format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')",
    "  )",
    "}",
    "",
    "#* Health check",
    "#* @get /health",
    "function() {",
    "  list(status = 'healthy', timestamp = format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'))",
    "}",
    "",
    "#* Model metadata",
    "#* @get /model/info",
    "function() {",
    "  list(",
    "    model_type = 'xgboost',",
    "    version = '1.0.0', auc = 0.789,",
    "    features = FEATURES,",
    "    trained_on = '2024-01-15', n_training = 2400",
    "  )",
    "}",
    "",
    "#* Single patient prediction",
    "#* @post /predict",
    "#* @parser json",
    "#* @serializer json",
    "function(req, res) {",
    "  body <- req$body",
    "  if (is.null(body)) body <- jsonlite::fromJSON(req$postBody)",
    "  errs <- validate_patient(body$age, body$los_days, body$diabetes, body$hf, body$copd)",
    "  if (length(errs)) {",
    "    res$status <- 400",
    "    return(list(error = '422 Unprocessable Entity', detail = paste(errs, collapse = '; ')))",
    "  }",
    "  predict_one(body$age, body$los_days, body$diabetes, body$hf, body$copd, body$patient_id)",
    "}",
    "",
    "#* Batch predictions",
    "#* @post /predict/batch",
    "#* @parser json",
    "#* @serializer json",
    "function(req, res) {",
    "  body <- req$body",
    "  if (is.null(body)) body <- jsonlite::fromJSON(req$postBody)",
    "  patients <- body$patients",
    "  if (is.data.frame(patients)) patients <- split(patients, seq_len(nrow(patients)))",
    "  results <- lapply(patients, function(p) {",
    "    errs <- validate_patient(p$age, p$los_days, p$diabetes, p$hf, p$copd)",
    "    if (length(errs)) return(list(patient_id = p$patient_id, error = paste(errs, collapse = '; ')))",
    "    out <- predict_one(p$age, p$los_days, p$diabetes, p$hf, p$copd, p$patient_id)",
    "    list(patient_id = out$patient_id, probability = out$readmission_probability,",
    "         risk_tier = out$risk_tier)",
    "  })",
    "  list(predictions = results, count = length(results))",
    "}",
    "",
    "# Run: plumber::pr('plumber.R') %>% plumber::pr_run(host = '0.0.0.0', port = 8000)"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)
cat("plumber application code (plumber.R):\n")
cat(substr(PLUMBER_APP, 1, 2000), "\n")
plumber_path <- file.path(mod08_dir, "plumber.R")
writeLines(PLUMBER_APP, plumber_path)
cat("\nplumber.R written to:", plumber_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
# pr / pr_run pattern (do not bind a port during knit)
PR_RUN_DEMO <- paste(
  c(
    "library(plumber)",
    "pr <- plumber::pr(file.path(tempdir(), 'mod08', 'plumber.R'))",
    "pr <- plumber::pr_set_debug(pr, TRUE)",
    "# plumber::pr_run(pr, host = '0.0.0.0', port = 8000)  # start the server",
    "# POST /predict  JSON body: {age, los_days, diabetes, hf, copd, patient_id}"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)
cat(PR_RUN_DEMO, "\n")
if (requireNamespace("plumber", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pr <- plumber::pr(plumber_path)
  cat("plumber::pr() loaded routes:\n")
  print(pr)
}
```

## 4. Request Validation & Predictions

```{r}
PatientFeatures <- function(age, los_days, diabetes, hf, copd, patient_id = NULL) {
  errors <- character()
  if (!(18 <= age && age <= 90)) errors <- c(errors, sprintf("age must be 18-90, got %s", age))
  if (!(1 <= los_days && los_days <= 60)) errors <- c(errors, sprintf("los_days must be 1-60, got %s", los_days))
  if (!diabetes %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, "diabetes must be 0 or 1")
  if (!hf %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, "hf must be 0 or 1")
  if (!copd %in% c(0, 1)) errors <- c(errors, "copd must be 0 or 1")
  if (length(errors)) stop(paste(errors, collapse = "; "))
  list(age = age, los_days = los_days, diabetes = diabetes, hf = hf, copd = copd,
       patient_id = patient_id)
}

predict_patient <- function(patient, model_obj) {
  X <- matrix(
    c(patient$age, patient$los_days, patient$diabetes, patient$hf, patient$copd),
    nrow = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, FEATURES)
  )
  prob <- as.numeric(predict(model_obj, X))
  tier <- if (prob < 0.10) "Low" else if (prob < 0.20) "Moderate" else if (prob < 0.35) "High" else "Very High"
  list(
    patient_id = patient$patient_id,
    readmission_probability = round(prob, 4),
    risk_tier = tier,
    model_version = "1.0.0"
  )
}

test_cases <- list(
  list(age = 72, los_days = 8, diabetes = 1, hf = 1, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-00142",
       label = "High-risk HF patient"),
  list(age = 35, los_days = 2, diabetes = 0, hf = 0, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-00289",
       label = "Low-risk young patient"),
  list(age = 200, los_days = 5, diabetes = 0, hf = 0, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-bad",
       label = "Invalid age"),
  list(age = 65, los_days = 10, diabetes = 2, hf = 0, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-bad2",
       label = "Invalid diabetes")
)

cat("plumber endpoint simulation (validation + prediction):\n")
cat(sprintf("%-35s %-8s %-8s %s\n", "Patient", "Status", "Prob", "Risk Tier"))
cat(strrep("-", 70), "\n")
for (tc in test_cases) {
  label <- tc$label
  tc$label <- NULL
  tryCatch({
    pt <- do.call(PatientFeatures, tc)
    result <- predict_patient(pt, model)
    cat(sprintf("  %-33s OK       %.4f  %s\n", label, result$readmission_probability, result$risk_tier))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-33s ERROR    %s\n", label, substr(e$message, 1, 35)))
  })
}
```

## 5. API Test Suite

```{r}
simulate_api_call <- function(endpoint, payload, model_obj) {
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  on.exit(cat(sprintf("  [%s] %.1fms\n", endpoint, (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0) * 1000)))
  tryCatch({
    if (endpoint == "/health") {
      return(list(status = "healthy", timestamp = "2024-01-15T10:30:00"))
    } else if (endpoint == "/predict") {
      needed <- c("age", "los_days", "diabetes", "hf", "copd")
      if (!all(needed %in% names(payload))) stop("Missing required fields")
      pt <- do.call(PatientFeatures, payload[intersect(names(payload), c(needed, "patient_id"))])
      return(predict_patient(pt, model_obj))
    } else if (endpoint == "/predict/batch") {
      results <- lapply(payload$patients, function(p) {
        pt <- do.call(PatientFeatures, p[intersect(names(p), c("age", "los_days", "diabetes", "hf", "copd", "patient_id"))])
        predict_patient(pt, model_obj)
      })
      return(list(predictions = results, count = length(results)))
    }
  }, error = function(e) list(error = e$message))
}

cat("API test suite simulation:\n\n")
cat("Test 1: Health check\n")
r <- simulate_api_call("/health", list(), model)
cat("  Response:", toJSON(r, auto_unbox = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nTest 2: Single prediction (high-risk)\n")
r <- simulate_api_call("/predict",
  list(age = 72, los_days = 12, diabetes = 1, hf = 1, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-00142"), model)
cat("  Response:\n")
cat(toJSON(r, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nTest 3: Batch prediction (3 patients)\n")
r <- simulate_api_call("/predict/batch", list(patients = list(
  list(age = 72, los_days = 12, diabetes = 1, hf = 1, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-001"),
  list(age = 45, los_days = 3, diabetes = 0, hf = 0, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-002"),
  list(age = 68, los_days = 7, diabetes = 1, hf = 0, copd = 1, patient_id = "PT-003")
)), model)
for (pred in r$predictions) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: prob=%.4f | tier=%s\n", pred$patient_id, pred$readmission_probability, pred$risk_tier))
}
```

## 6. Docker Deployment

```{r}
DOCKER_COMPOSE <- paste(
  c(
    "version: '3.8'",
    "services:",
    "  api:",
    "    build: .",
    "    ports:",
    "      - '8000:8000'",
    "    environment:",
    "      - MODEL_PATH=/app/models/readmission_model.rds",
    "      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO",
    "      - ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://dashboard.healthsystem.org",
    "    volumes:",
    "      - ./models:/app/models:ro  # read-only model mount",
    "    healthcheck:",
    "      test: ['CMD','curl','-f','http://localhost:8000/health']",
    "      interval: 30s",
    "      timeout: 10s",
    "      retries: 3",
    "    restart: unless-stopped",
    "",
    "  nginx:",
    "    image: nginx:alpine",
    "    ports:",
    "      - '443:443'",
    "    volumes:",
    "      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro",
    "      - /etc/ssl/certs:/etc/ssl/certs:ro",
    "    depends_on: [api]"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

DOCKERFILE <- paste(
  c(
    "FROM rocker/r-ver:4.3.1",
    "WORKDIR /app",
    "COPY packages.R .",
    "RUN Rscript packages.R",
    "COPY plumber.R .",
    "COPY models/ models/",
    "RUN useradd -m appuser && chown -R appuser /app",
    "USER appuser",
    "EXPOSE 8000",
    "CMD [\"Rscript\", \"-e\", \"plumber::pr('plumber.R') |> plumber::pr_run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)\"]"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

cat("Dockerfile:\n")
cat(DOCKERFILE, "\n")
cat("\ndocker-compose.yml:\n")
cat(DOCKER_COMPOSE, "\n")

writeLines(DOCKERFILE, file.path(mod08_dir, "Dockerfile"))
writeLines(DOCKER_COMPOSE, file.path(mod08_dir, "docker-compose.yml"))
cat("Files written to", mod08_dir, "\n")
```

## 7. API Performance & Clinical Considerations

```{r}
BATCH_SIZES <- c(1, 10, 50, 100, 500)
test_patient <- c(age = 65, los_days = 7, diabetes = 1, hf = 0, copd = 0)

latencies <- sapply(BATCH_SIZES, function(batch_size) {
  X_batch <- matrix(rep(test_patient, batch_size), nrow = batch_size, byrow = TRUE,
                    dimnames = list(NULL, FEATURES))
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  for (i in 1:20) predict(model, X_batch)
  (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0) / 20 * 1000
})

lat_df <- tibble(batch = BATCH_SIZES, ms = as.numeric(latencies))
p_lat <- ggplot(lat_df, aes(batch, ms)) +
  geom_line(colour = col_blue, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(colour = col_blue, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1fms", ms)), vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Batch size (# patients)", y = "Latency (ms)",
    title = "API Prediction Latency by Batch Size\n(xgboost model, simulated endpoint)"
  )
print(p_lat)
ggsave(file.path(mod08_dir, "api_latency.png"), p_lat, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 150, bg = "white")

cat("Clinical API requirements:\n")
cat("  EHR integration    : < 500ms (synchronous calls within order workflow)\n")
cat("  Batch discharge    : < 5s for 500 patients (overnight discharge planning)\n")
cat("  Model loading      : one-time at startup, NOT per request (readRDS once in plumber.R)\n")
cat("  Rate limiting      : typically 100 req/min per client IP\n")
cat("  PHI handling       : patient_id in request is optional; never log PHI in plaintext\n")
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. A clinician enters `age=-5` in the EHR interface. What HTTP status code should your API return and why?
2. Your batch endpoint receives 10,000 patients. How do you handle this without blocking other requests?
3. The API is integrated into the EHR. A code deploy breaks the `/predict` endpoint. What should your health check return?
4. A researcher wants to use the API for a study pulling 500,000 predictions. What rate limiting approach protects the production system?
5. Add an `/explain` endpoint that returns the top 3 SHAP feature contributions for a single patient prediction.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — /explain endpoint with DALEX / feature importance
explain_prediction <- function(patient_dict, model_obj, features = FEATURES) {
  X <- matrix(
    unlist(patient_dict[features]), nrow = 1,
    dimnames = list(NULL, features)
  )
  prob <- as.numeric(predict(model_obj, X))
  imp <- tryCatch({
    xgb.importance(model = model_obj)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(Feature = features, Gain = rep(1 / length(features), length(features)))
  })
  top3 <- head(imp, 3)
  list(
    patient_id = patient_dict$patient_id,
    readmission_probability = round(prob, 4),
    risk_tier = if (prob > 0.35) "High" else if (prob > 0.20) "Moderate" else "Low",
    top_3_drivers = lapply(seq_len(nrow(top3)), function(i) {
      list(
        feature = as.character(top3$Feature[i]),
        importance = round(as.numeric(top3$Gain[i]), 4),
        direction = "increases risk"
      )
    })
  )
}

pt <- list(age = 72, los_days = 12, diabetes = 1, hf = 1, copd = 0, patient_id = "PT-00142")
result <- explain_prediction(pt, model)
cat("POST /explain response:\n")
cat(toJSON(result, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE), "\n")
```
